description: This file implements a notes tree data structure and associated functions for managing notes in a Git repository. It includes definitions for internal nodes, leaf nodes, and non-note entries, as well as functions for loading, inserting, removing, and formatting notes, and handling on-disk tree structures.

classes.name: int_node
classes.description: Internal node of the notes tree, containing an array of 16 pointers to child nodes.

classes.name: leaf_node
classes.description: Leaf node representing a note or subtree entry, containing key and value object IDs.

classes.name: non_note
classes.description: Structure for tracking non-note entries in the notes tree, with path, mode, and object ID.

classes.name: notes_tree
classes.description: Main structure representing a notes tree, including root node, references, and configuration.

classes.name: tree_write_stack
classes.description: Helper structure for writing tree objects, maintaining a stack of tree levels and paths.

classes.name: write_each_note_data
classes.description: Data structure for passing context during note writing operations, including stack and non-note list.

classes.name: note_delete_list
classes.description: Linked list for tracking notes to be deleted during pruning.

methods.name: load_subtree
methods.description: Loads a subtree from disk into the in-memory notes tree structure.

methods.name: note_tree_search
methods.description: Searches for the appropriate location for a given key in the notes tree.

methods.name: note_tree_find
methods.description: Finds a note entry matching a given key.

methods.name: note_tree_consolidate
methods.description: Consolidates an internal node if it has only one non-null child.

methods.name: note_tree_remove
methods.description: Removes a note entry from the notes tree.

methods.name: note_tree_insert
methods.description: Inserts a note or subtree entry into the notes tree.

methods.name: note_tree_free
methods.description: Frees all memory associated with a notes tree.

methods.name: add_non_note
methods.description: Adds a non-note entry to the notes tree's non-note list.

methods.name: load_notes_trees
methods.description: Loads multiple notes trees from a list of references.

methods.name: init_notes
methods.description: Initializes a notes tree from a reference, loading data from disk.

methods.name: get_note
methods.description: Retrieves the note object ID associated with a given object ID.

methods.name: for_each_note
methods.description: Iterates over all notes in a notes tree, applying a callback.

methods.name: write_notes_tree
methods.description: Serializes a notes tree into a disk object.

methods.name: prune_notes
methods.description: Removes notes that no longer have corresponding objects.

methods.name: free_notes
methods.description: Frees all memory associated with a notes tree.

methods.name: format_note
methods.description: Formats a note for display, optionally re-encoding text.

methods.name: format_display_notes
methods.description: Formats all display notes for a given object.

methods.name: copy_note
methods.description: Copies a note from one object to another, optionally forcing overwrite.

methods.name: expand_notes_ref
methods.description: Expands a notes reference to full ref namespace.

methods.name: expand_loose_notes_ref
methods.description: Expands a loose notes reference, falling back if invalid.
